notes: Single source of truth for bridge tool schemas; both CLI and session backends must serve these definitions unchanged.
Session-only tools (M1+) are gated by the 'backends' field.

tools.name: analyze_mesh
tools.title: Analyze mesh
tools.description: Structural analysis of a model file (STL/OBJ/PLY/3MF): dimensions, volume, surface area, watertightness, component count. Pure geometry, no slicing.

tools.name: check_printability
tools.title: Check printability
tools.description: Heuristic FDM printability screen: build-volume fit, minimum feature size vs nozzle/layer, overhang burden, watertightness. Heuristics only - slice for a definitive verdict.

build_volume_mm.description: Printer build volume as [x, y, z] in mm (optional)

overhang_angle_deg.description: Angles steeper than this from horizontal need support

tools.name: suggest_orientation
tools.title: Suggest orientation
tools.description: Rank candidate build orientations by exposed overhang area (support burden). Geometric starting point; combine with cosmetic/strength judgement.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.title: Estimate cost
tools.description: Rough pre-slice estimate of material, time, and optional money cost from mesh volume plus shell+infill assumptions. Slice for exact numbers.

tools.name: list_params
tools.title: List print parameters
tools.description: Query the Orca print-parameter catalog (generated from print_config_def): label, tooltip, type, enums, min/max, scope (machine/process/filament).

tools.name: set_and_slice
tools.title: Set parameters and slice (headless CLI)
tools.description: Slice a model headlessly via the Orca CLI with parameter overrides. Returns the G-code path plus statistics parsed from the G-code footer. Mesh inputs (stl/obj) require presets; Orca project 3mf inputs reuse their embedded settings. Known upstream limitation: some newer-version Orca project 3mf files crash the CLI slicer - the error is reported cleanly, use mesh input instead.

overrides.description: Print parameter overrides, e.g. {"layer_height": 0.16, "sparse_infill_density": "25%"}; keys must be catalog parameters (see list_params)

printer_preset.description: Machine preset name or json path, e.g. 'Snapmaker Artisan (0.4 nozzle)'

process_preset.description: Process preset name or json path

filament_presets.description: Filament preset names/paths, one per extruder

output_dir.description: Where to write the G-code (defaults to a temp dir)

allow_newer_file.description: Accept 3mf files written by newer Orca versions

tools.name: export_3mf
tools.title: Export 3mf
tools.description: Get the model as a 3mf. 3mf input is copied through; mesh input is wrapped into a minimal valid 3mf. Full project export (settings + thumbnails) is available from the session backend (Orca running, M1+).
